description: List the third-party MCP servers attached to a project and the tools each allows. Configuration only: those tools are not callable here, but an actor in a run (checklist, interview, workflow) may call the allowed tools of servers whose in_force is true. Servers are registered and attached by workspace admins in the dashboard.
name: list_project_mcp_servers

allowed_tools.description: Allowlist of tool names the run may call. Empty means every tool the server offers.

attachment_enabled.description: This project's own switch on the server.

auth_mode.description: How the server authenticates: none, workspace (one admin-set credential) or user (each person connects their own).

enabled.description: The workspace registry switch for this server.

id.description: Workspace registry UUID of the MCP server.

in_force.description: True only when both the registry and the attachment switches are on, which is what makes its tools available to runs.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the dashboard.

name.description: Machine name the run sees the server under.

tool_timeout_ms.description: Per-call timeout in milliseconds. Null uses the default.

transport.description: How the run connects: http or sse.

title: List project MCP servers
